title: Bunk Bed Twin Over Twin, Wood Low Profile Floor Twin Bunk Beds with Headboard Ladder Guardrails for Kids Boys and Girls, No Box Spring Needed

reviews.title: GREAT BANG FOR YOUR BUCK!
reviews.body: Such a great low bunk bed, we were not yet ready to put our 5&6 year olds in a high bunk bed but our new house called for the extra room space for playing so bunk bed for the win. This was easy to assemble, affordable, and great quality overall. The pink is also so cute for our girlies! It’s also very light and sturdy, and a standard set of Walmart twin mattresses fit perfectly!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 12, 2025
reviews.author: Shelbieg98

reviews.title: Love it so much, I bought two!
reviews.body: One person build, sturdy quality wood, overall perfect and exactly what I was looking for! I have 4 young kids and bought one set and the second set a week later because I loved it so much!Only thing I’d change would be measuring inside and cutting some plywood to reinforce the top bunk  if you have little wild jumpers like I do!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on February 7, 2026
reviews.author: Kirsten

reviews.title: Good purchase!
reviews.body: I really like the lower profile.I bought two so that all 4 of my youngest grandchildren would have their own sleeping spot when they are staying the night. They are ages 5-8.Beds are sturdy and can hold up to 250#s.Putting them together was not hard  all pieces that were supposed to be included – were.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on August 28, 2025
reviews.author: SKH

reviews.title: Great bed but color if natural not as "natural"
reviews.body: Great loft style bed! Easy to assemble with clear directions. I gave it a 4 because even though it is a great bed, the color is far too yellow for the "natural" color I ordered. The shipping cost is far too expensive for me to return even though the color was way off. I'll learn to live with it, I just wish it was the color I had wanted!

reviews.title: Love them!
reviews.body: I have two step sons that really needed new beds but I didn’t have a lot of extra money. Plus all the reviews I saw on bunk beds made me nervous to even get them. It seemed they were either unstable or creaked or didn’t support enough weight. But I took a chance on these anyway because Ioved that the bottom bunk was on the floor so I didn’t have to worry about weight at all with that one and the younger one could sleep on top. These bunks are beautiful and very sturdy. I love them.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on January 22, 2025
reviews.author: Brandy M. Marshall

features: 【Low Floor Bunk Bed】This twin size floor bunk bed is suitable for rooms with low ceilings and for families with many children. The low height of the bed ensures better stability, reducing safety concerns. In addition, the ladder is designed with a wider width to provide more spacious steps and solid support, making it easier for you to climb up and down the ladder.
【Sturdy Wooden Bunk Bed】This wood twin bunk bed is made of sturdy and high-quality solid wood structure, which is durable and has a strong load-bearing capacity, ensuring a longer service life.

Overall Product Dimension: 77.3” L x 43.9” W x 46.6” H. Number of Slats: 13 pcs(Upper Bed)/7 pcs(Bottom Bed). Bed Weight Capacity: 250 lbs(Upper Bed)/250 lbs(Bottom Bed). Suggested Mattress Thickness: 6 inches or less(Mattress not included).

【Simple and Stylish】This low bed bunk twin over twin size comes in a sophisticated and clean-silhouette style appearance, emphasizing the elegance and simplicity of the piece. Enabling the bed to merge perfectly into any scenario. Moreover, there is a variety of classic colors that you can choose from, which you believe will suit your children's bedroom the most.

【Easy Assembly】This floor bunk bed twin over twin comes with all the needed parts, tools, and simple and clear instructions for user-friendly assembly. We also promise 180 days warranty including all accessories. 1-2 adults can finish the installation within 0.5-1 hour.
